node.statement: By the allowed external GT-hatcher-AT-thm-3.15 (Hatcher, Theorem 3.15, refs/hatcher-algebraic-topology/AT.txt:13505-13506), for arbitrary coefficient ring R, if X and Y are CW complexes and H^k(Y;R) is a finitely generated free R-module for every k, then the cross product H*(X;R) (x)_R H*(Y;R) -> H*(X x Y;R) is an isomorphism of rings.
